component.name: ProgramaItem
component.script: function init() as void m.moldura = m.top.findNode("moldura") m.top.observeField("itemContent", "onConteudo") m.top.observeField("focusPercent", "onFoco") m.top.observeField("listHasFocus", "onFoco") end function function onConteudo() as void c = m.top.itemContent if c = invalid then return m.top.findNode("hora").text = c.hora m.top.findNode("titulo").text = c.title m.top.findNode("detalhe").text = c.description tem = c.progresso > 0 m.top.findNode("trilho").visible = tem b = m.top.findNode("barra") b.visible = tem b.width = Int(640 * c.progresso) end function function onFoco() as void m.moldura.visible = m.top.focusPercent > 0.5 and m.top.listHasFocus end function
